'''Chamber of Cleansing''' was the name of a cave located in the [[Gormak Lands]] on [[Voss]]. It was used as a place to enter the [[Spirit World]] by the [[dream-walkers]] such as the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Hadrik]], one of the few non-[[Voss (species)|Voss]] dream-walkers.<ref name="The Ritual" /> Around [[3640 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|Voss}}</ref> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] visited the Chamber to contact Hadrik in the Spirit World.<ref name="The Ritual" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chamber of Cleansing appears as a location in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.<ref name="The Ritual" />
